name: Loot in a scaled dungeon scales down to a level-16 looter (#9256, #9548)
contract: #9256/#9548: a level-16/22 character in a Random Dungeon Finder run of a vanilla dungeon found the dropped
gear unusable. Gnomeregan (map 90) is LFGDungeons.dbc id 14, in DEFAULT_SCALING_DUNGEONS
to scale down to the looter's own level whatever their or their leader's open-world switch. War Master Voone
9237 drops Flightblade Throwing Axe 28972 (item level 57, required level 55, 5 stamina, 8 attack power) at
100%. ItemLadder::ClientKey(16) = 16 + 2 = 18 (AscensionItemLadder.cpp), so a level-16 looter's drop key is
18; ItemStat.dbc's row for item 28972 at level 18 (parsed directly: RequiredLevel field, stat type 7
(stamina) and 38 (attack power)) carries required level 17, 1 stamina and 1 attack power. Native item
scaling (CoA.ItemScaling.Native, default on) must assign that level-18 ladder row to the looted axe instead
of leaving it at its authored item level 57 / required level 55, which a level-16 character could not equip.

steps.label: The corpse holds the authored Flightblade Throwing Axe
DISCRIMINATING: the item-level-57 axe scales down to the client key 18 for the looter's level 16
The axe requires the row's level 17 instead of 55
The axe carries the row's 1 stamina instead of 5
The axe carries the row's 1 attack power instead of 8
